observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher breaks down advanced hip-hop choreography step by step with clear verbal cues and demonstrations facing the mirror. He encourages students not to get discouraged and offers styling options for different parts of the routine.

lesson_structure.note: Teacher introduces himself and the routine
Full demonstration of the choreography with music and dancers
Detailed breakdown of the first half of the routine starting with arm movements

steps_taught.name: Arm scoop and step back
steps_taught.description: Scoop right arm across body, step out on right leg and push left hand underneath.

steps_taught.name: Swings and punch
steps_taught.description: Swing right arm and step back, then punch with right arm.

steps_taught.name: Pottys and body roll
steps_taught.description: Do pottypaws / grapevine footwork combined with body rolls and chest pops.

what_works: breaking down complex arms and footwork separately
repeating the counts and visual checks in the mirror
what_hinders: fast transition between footwork and arm styling for advanced level

quotes.text: Don't beat yourself up, that's normal.
Start out with your right arm going across your body.
I'm really popping my chest up on those hits.

evidence_segments.observation: Teacher demonstrates arm scoop and head movement facing the mirror.

extraction.distinctive_method: Encouraging mindset coaching alongside technical breakdown, normalizing initial failure for advanced choreography.
